title: Four O'Clock Prices
logline: Before dawn at a great wholesale vegetable market, lorries arrive all at once, prices change by the minute, and a trader juggles buyers, a phone and a scale until the rush breaks into sudden quiet.

object.note: Object 4 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: From a reservoir's slow, silent mud to a wholesale market where lorries arrive all at once and attention scatters as fast as prices change.

thread_out.thread: After the rush breaks into sudden quiet, a different kind of lostness: mangrove channels where every turning looks the same, and a fisher who reads the roots like streets.

requirements: A working wholesale market with a trader willing to be followed for a whole night
Safe camera positions among moving lorries and carts

suggestions.name: Dambulla Dedicated Economic Centre
suggestions.why: The best-known wholesale vegetable market in Sri Lanka, where produce from many regions changes hands.
suggestions.access_notes: Very busy; filming needs management permission
suggestions.verify: Trading hours, filming permissions and a willing trader are unverified.
